title: Monotone decision-tree learning program
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $d$, and a rational parameter $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$, define a random-example learning program that returns a sparse Fourier hypothesis on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube. It is the bounded-influence random-example program with the influence bound associated with decision-tree size at most $d$ and parameter $\varepsilon$.
caveat: The supplied snippet omits the definitions of the bounded-influence program and the decision-tree-size influence bound, so their precise construction cannot be rendered from the given ground truth.
